title: Providence, RI — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]

content:
Overview

Providence is a city in RI with a population of 190,934. Creative Capital with Brown University, WaterFire, and New England charm. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The population skews young, with a median age of 32.9.
